title: Fixed Helm runner source references
description: At most 2 KiB, stable Secret references and an optional public continuation digest. Never private material or generated installation pins. The fixed sequential runner preserves the original effect journals and separate credential mounts.

continuationDigest.description: Full SHA-256 of the immutable continuation.json bytes. Its ConfigMap name is derived from the original bootstrap name and the first 32 digest characters; the full digest binds the runner input.
